passages.text: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is King.
He rules over all.
All nations should tremble before Him.
He sits enthroned above the cherubim.
The earth should quake at His presence.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is great in Zion.
He is exalted above all peoples.
The LORD rules from Zion.
He stands high over every nation.
No one is above Him.
He is greater than all.
passages.original: יְ֭הוָה בְּצִיּ֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וְרָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל־ כָּל־ הָֽעַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy.
His name is great.
His name is awesome.
Let the people praise His name.
passages.original: יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the mighty King.
The LORD loves justice.
The LORD established fairness.
The LORD did what is just in Jacob.
The LORD did what is right in Jacob.
passages.original: וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב׀ אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃

passages.text: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
He is holy.
Exalt the LORD.
Worship at His footstool.
passages.original: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.
passages.sermon:
Moses and Aaron served as priests of the LORD.
Samuel called on the name of the LORD.
Moses, Aaron, and Samuel called to the LORD.
The LORD answered them.
passages.original: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן׀ בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם׃

passages.text: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to them.
He spoke from the pillar of cloud.
They obeyed His decrees.
They kept the statutes He gave them.
passages.original: בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן־ לָֽמוֹ׃

passages.text: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
He answered Moses, Aaron, and Samuel.
He forgave them.
He punished them for their wrong actions.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל־ עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
The LORD is holy.
Exalt the LORD our God.
Worship at His holy mountain.
passages.original: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
